title: Talk: Exploradoras del futuro
subtitle: Inspiring young women to get involved in STEM
preview: We visited Morrorico neighborhood to motivate the youth to study STEM fields...
content:
Last May 9th, WIE UIS partnered with Bucaratech and Women in Tech to visit more than 30 children from the Morrorico neighborhood in Bucaramanga. The goal of this visit was to motivate young women from the community to explore STEM-related fields, taking that into account, we decided to put together some activities that were aimed towards the computer sciences field.

By the end of the day, the kids had learned about the history of computer science, how the field has evolved to where it is today, and some of its current applications such as computer vision. It was a rewarding experience for everyone involved.

Want to keep up with our activities? Follow us on Instagram for updates!

title: Ingeniamujer Week
subtitle: Trayectorias con impacto
preview: This year we started a new series of activities called Ingeniamujer: Trayectorias con impacto, held the week before international women's day...
content:
To commemorate International Women's Day, WIE UIS organized our first ever Ingeniamujer Week, held between March 2nd and March 6th. The event brought together a variety of activities designed to create meaningful spaces for women in STEM:

  • Film screenings
  • Guided visits
  • Talks by women researchers
  • Workshops

Our goals were: to promote spaces where women could acquire new knowledge in STEM fields, to help women researchers share their findings with a wider audience, and to celebrate culture through our film screenings.

Talks

We held three talks covering exciting topics: imaging, renewable energies, and optical physics, all delivered by remarkable women working in these fields.

Guided Visits

We also organized two guided visits. The first took place at UIS' research laboratories in Guatiguará, where participants got a firsthand look at where much of UIS' cutting-edge research happens. The second was a visit to GOTS (Grupo de Óptica y Tratamiento de Señales), UIS' optical physics research group.

We are thrilled with the results of our first Ingeniamujer Week and are already looking forward to creating more spaces like this. If you would like to support this goal, contact us — we would love to hear from you!
